name: agent-team
displayName: Agent Team — Lead, Coder, Verifier and Cross-Vendor Reviewer
description: Run a team of coding agents the way a small engineering org does: a lead writes tasks with measurable acceptance checks, coders work in isolated worktrees, a verifier runs the real checks, a reviewer from a different vendor judges the diff, and a done-gate decides. Includes overnight batch runs and a morning report.
